property_summary: For any amounts, a withdrawAll whose payout triggers a reentrant withdrawAll from another funded depositor must revert (the lock blocks re-entry and the failed inner call propagates); deleting the lock set lets the reentrant call succeed, so the whole call completes instead of reverting.
change_summary: Delete `__lock_modifier0_lock = true;` in the modifier, removing the reentrancy guard so a reentrant call to withdrawAll can execute.
